summary: This class examines whether the custom or obligation of Shnayim Mikra VeEhad Targum includes reading the weekly Haftarah. Rabbi Harari explores the rulings of the Shulhan Arukh and the Rama, analyzing the underlying dispute between Rabbeinu Simha and Rabbeinu Hananel regarding the core purpose of preparing the weekly reading. He also presents the explanation of the Magen Abraham and contemporary rulings on whether preparing the Haftarah is necessary today.
questions: Does the obligation of Shnayim Mikra VeEhad Targum include reading the Haftarah?
Why does the Rama mention a custom to read the Haftarah while the Shulhan Arukh omits it?
What are the two major opinions among Rishonim regarding the purpose of Shnayim Mikra?
How does modern synagogue practice regarding who reads the Haftarah affect whether one must prepare it beforehand?
